opening.argument: The promoted Forsage BUSD system is presented through highly outsized daily-income claims. The description states, “I make 17k in just a Single Day,” while the speaker attributes even larger recurring amounts to Forsage: “the income is 20, 25, 30 40 lakhs, 1 lakhs, 2 lakhs on daily basis” [1][2]. These figures are not offered as neutral commentary. Viewers seeking that level of income are told to respond, and the speaker adds that the response “will tell you how to earn” [3][4]. Taken together, the earning claims and direct invitation establish a solicitation to participate in the promoted investment, lending or staking-return system.
